articles.title: Three Azim Premji University students selected for EnviroChamp Fellowship 2026

articles.title: DASA, CSAB Special Counselling 2026 registration begins; Fee payment ends August 3

Candidates can complete registration and fee payment until August 3, while the first special round seat allotment will be announced on August 6.

articles.title: PSEB Supplementary result 2026 expected any time; Punjab Board Class 10, 12 compartment scores awaited at pseb.ac.in
